indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Rose broadly as midterm results removed a major source of uncertainty.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Big cloud names rallied, though memory and chip stocks fell sharply.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Jumped about 1,569 points, its strongest post-midterm day in decades.

notes: Democrats won control of both the House and Senate; investors read a divided government as lowering the odds of big policy shifts, and stocks recovered from an early dip into a broad rally.
Large cloud providers led tech: Microsoft and Amazon each rose about 6–7% and Alphabet gained 3–4%, while memory makers such as Micron, Seagate and SanDisk fell 7–8% and the chip index lost about 3%.

Oil slumped, with WTI down roughly 8% to about $88 on the election outcome and signs of diplomacy with Iran, hitting energy stocks; the 10-year Treasury yield eased to about 4.89% and gold rose about 3%.
events: Thu 5 Nov: counting continues in uncalled House races and the Alaska and Mississippi Senate contests.
Fri 6 Nov, 16:30 Kuwait time: US October jobs report.
